card.name: Words before an exposure or subject phrase
card.fires_on: Small linking words or adjectives such as from, of, the, whether, immune, drawn, worthy, where the next words name something a subject is exposed to, protected from, or studied for. It is most visible after words like protected, study, immune and effects.

modes.label: Protection or immunity from
modes.description: Word after protected or immune, leading into what is guarded against or exposed to.
modes.example: They are also "protected"<< from>> active interference by opponents within their own goal

modes.label: Definition or study of
modes.description: Linking word after a statement of what something studies or determines.
modes.example: Aerodynamics is the study<< of>> the way objects move through air.

modes.label: Effects on or from a source
modes.description: Linking word before a source or condition in a clause about risk or effects.
modes.example: any potential adverse effects on the breastfed infant<< from>> chlordiazepoxide hydrochloride

card.writes: It seems to steer the next word away from words for suffering or enduring something and toward other continuations.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words that introduce what someone is protected from, exposed to, or what is being studied.
